capabilities: Align corresponding lines across two adjacent panes
Synchronize scrolling between the two panes
Insert view-only spacer gaps to compensate for differing line heights
Toggle line alignment from the command palette
Show alignment state in the status bar
disambiguation: It does not translate text or match paragraphs by meaning; alignment is purely by source line number.
extras: README states the plugin was generated by AI and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop only, no mobile or Reading view support; makes no network requests.
problem: Reading a source text and its translation side by side in Obsidian drifts out of alignment because wrapping and line heights differ between panes.
summary: Line-alignment tool that keeps corresponding lines of two side-by-side Live Preview notes aligned and scroll-synced, aimed at translators.
